title: Debug a Failing CI Run from Logs in 30 Seconds
description:
Your CI run just went red? Read the log first! 🔴

✅ Get only the failed log with gh run view --log-failed
✅ Paste it to AI and ask what broke
✅ Fix the typo in the test step and watch CI go green

Day 8 of AI Debugging. Next up: Day 9, Stop the AI Fix-Break-Fix Loop.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #githubactions #devops #cicd
comment: Typo or version: which breaks your CI more? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: gh run view --log-failed prints only the logs of the steps that failed, so you can paste just that into your AI chat.
